dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Pronounced concave spline on the trailing edge, transitioning from a vertical apex to a horizontal base insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximate 40-degree linear slope relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.1:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive light-toned depigmentation patches and irregular mottling across the lower lateral fin and dorsal region; minor notch present on the lower trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast speckled pattern of white spots concentrated along the lower portion of the visible peduncle and fin base.
